report_name: Microsoft Links Ransomware Affiliate Storm-2570 to Four Malware Families

threat_actors.name: Storm-2570
threat_actors.description: A prolific ransomware affiliate active since at least April 2025, observed deploying multiple ransomware families (Qilin, DragonForce, Anubis, BERT) using a consistent set of TTPs. The group operates under multiple Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) banners.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 transferred and renamed legitimate RMM tools such as MeshAgent, Atera, NinjaRMM, and ScreenConnect for persistence and command and control.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping: NTDS
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 used the native Windows utility ntdsutil to create a copy of the Active Directory database (ntds.dit) for offline credential extraction.

attack_patterns.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 used PowerShell commands such as 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true' to disable Microsoft Defender's real-time protection.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Before deploying ransomware, Storm-2570 exfiltrated stolen data using tools like s5cmd and Rclone to upload archives to attacker-controlled cloud storage.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: As the final step of the attack, Storm-2570 deployed ransomware payloads such as Qilin to encrypt files across the victim network.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 used legitimate remote management and monitoring (RMM) software, including MeshAgent, Atera, NinjaRMM, and ScreenConnect, for persistence and command and control.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 used various tools like Mimikatz, LaZagne, and pypykatz to harvest credentials from compromised systems.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: Storm-2570 used tools like PsExec, Impacket, and NetExec to move laterally across the network to other systems.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: One of four distinct ransomware families deployed by the Storm-2570 affiliate as the final payload to encrypt victim files.

malware.description: One of four distinct ransomware families deployed by the Storm-2570 affiliate. Although known as a banking trojan, it was used as a ransomware payload in this context.

indicators.name: Storm-2570 Unauthorized RMM Tool Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Storm-2570 Unauthorized RMM Tool Execution
id: 2a1b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of legitimate RMM tools often abused by the Storm-2570 affiliate for command and control.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/24/beyond-ransomware-tracking-storm-2570-consistent-tradecraft-across-deployments/
tags:
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\NinjaRMM.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of RMM tools (MeshAgent, Atera, NinjaRMM) commonly abused by Storm-2570 for C2 and persistence.

indicators.name: NTDS.dit Database Creation via ntdsutil
indicators.pattern:
title: NTDS.dit Database Creation via ntdsutil
id: 3b2c4d5e-6f7a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of ntdsutil.exe to create a copy of the Active Directory database (ntds.dit), a technique used by Storm-2570 for credential harvesting.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/24/beyond-ransomware-tracking-storm-2570-consistent-tradecraft-across-deployments/
tags:
  - attack.t1003.003
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command-line pattern for creating an Install From Media (IFM) copy of the Active Directory database, a TTP of Storm-2570.

indicators.name: Microsoft Defender Real-Time Monitoring Disabled via PowerShell
indicators.pattern:
title: Microsoft Defender Real-Time Monitoring Disabled via PowerShell
id: 4c3d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects the PowerShell command used to disable Microsoft Defender's real-time monitoring, a defense evasion technique used by Storm-2570.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/24/beyond-ransomware-tracking-storm-2570-consistent-tradecraft-across-deployments/
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: ps_script
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the PowerShell command 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true' used by Storm-2570 to impair defenses.

indicators.name: Storm-2570 Data Exfiltration Tool Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Storm-2570 Data Exfiltration Tool Execution
id: 5d4e6f7a-8b9c-4d0e-1f2a-3b4c5d6e7f8g
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of Rclone or s5cmd, tools used by the Storm-2570 affiliate to exfiltrate data to cloud storage.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-25
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/09/24/beyond-ransomware-tracking-storm-2570-consistent-tradecraft-across-deployments/
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\s5cmd.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of data exfiltration tools Rclone and s5cmd, which are part of Storm-2570's playbook.
